result.summary: One visual issue: a loading spinner is overlaid on a fully rendered restaurant card, creating a broken/in-progress look.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner sits on top of the already-loaded Tokumaru Ramen Bar card (image, title, rating, and delivery info are all visible), which looks like a stuck or misplaced loading state.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the card content is ready, or show a dedicated skeleton/placeholder instead of overlaying a spinner on finished content.
